prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results in Rounds 1 and 3.
Predictions were slightly too low in Round 4 compared to noise-corrected results.
The single test for 'adoption, new_flow' won (+2.7% after noise correction), but category evidence remains thin.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, redesign' or 'finish, new_screen' in their single tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress and Background Notification Info: Enable time estimates and desktop completion notification toggles on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336 seconds and 81.3% conversion, causing users to abandon during background load.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Path Order: Move sign-in after pet selection so users choose their companion before creating an account. (why: Early drop-off at choose_path (76.2%) and sign_in (72.9%) creates upfront friction before emotional attachment.)
2: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Naming Clarification: Clarify certificate customization fields with explicit hints on how pet names and traits appear on the desktop display. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet issues and adoption screen conversion drops to 64.8%.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Path Options Spotlight Layout: Switch choose_path layout to spotlight to make path decisions immediate and clear. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite 8s median, showing long tail confusion when picking options.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Command Shortcut Hint: Add an explicit tray icon and hotkey command hint to the home intro screen. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Instant Sign-In Failover Status Banner: Add a fallback status banner and instant retry component to the sign-in screen to handle network stalls gracefully. (why: Support noted sign-in screen failing to appear or stalling before authentication completes.)

scores.note: High mean wait time (2336s) on home step; notifications help reduce drop-offs.
Reduces upfront friction by delaying sign-in until after companion selection.
Backed by 3 support tickets and 35.2% drop; cost-effective copy fix.
Addresses large mean duration gap (514s vs 8s median) on choose_path.
Directly resolves 3 support tickets about post-onboarding controls via simple hint.
Fixes sign-in stalls reported in support emails with fallback status UI.
